text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, after T.M. Opera O has a
number of
victories under her belt...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. It seems the time has finally
come,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
We must break the seal on Pandora's
box and
unleash its dormant hopes and
dreams upon the
world!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Now, bring forth the box!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Alas, this is almost woeful... Have you
forgotten
about our prize?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Think back, Trainer! We were strolling
through
the shopping district during the
New Year's
holiday...

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a
grand-prize
winner! Come and get the
ticket for your hot
spring vacation!
Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
A hot spring vacation? How delightful. I
would
dare depart this instant, if only I
could.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Close it with wax using the king's seal
and keep it
safe until the appropriate
time comes.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Now do you recall?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, and now that the Twinkle Series has
ended, a
period of rest is in order.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The Centurial Overlord requires
centurial
rejuvenation! Let us make for
the Centurial Hot
Springs!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There aren't actually any hot springs of
that
name, but we manage to find our
vacation spot.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We soak ourselves in the hot spring.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Sigh... The water is fine, indeed. But now... Ahh! I feel an urge.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The hot water has soaked into my
already
gorgeous skin, making it glisten
like a freshly-cut
diamond.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Tonight, the midnight sun awaits, for my
beauty
shall illuminate the world long
after sunset.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
My enhanced resplendence will become
a
fountain bursting with pristine water!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Do you even need an answer? Let us go!
choice_data_list_en: Should we go eat kaiseki cuisine?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Peculiar... My ascension to Centurial
Overlord has
not fazed you in the
slightest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With Opera O's monologue now
finished, we go
back to our room and
enjoy the delicious food.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ahh, that was absolutely divine. My

preoccupation may be with the Western
arts, but
an Eastern flare is nice every
now and again.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Trainer. Now is the perfect

opportunity to ask...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Are your evaluations of me truly accurate?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Very well, I shall explain.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I am strong! I am fast! I am proud and
invincible!
Tens of thousands have made
that realization.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You have spoken of my strength and

complimented my skills, which is fine.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
But I am also beautiful on top of all that!
Just as I
have said many times before.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You have rarely, if at all, described me
with this
word.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It may be my imagination... But your
ability to
judge aesthetics may be
lacking.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's upset I don't compliment her
looks, I guess.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
So, I ask you now. If you feel that I am
not
beautiful, you are free to say so.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Your opinion has no impact on the truth. I am beautiful, regardless of what you think.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And yet, even if so, I wish to hear it! I
want to be
clear on your feelings.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Do you think that I am... beautiful?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
How do I respond? I take a moment and
say...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Really? Do you truly, truly believe so?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I-I see...
choice_data_list: ああ、とっても美しいって
うん、とっても美しいよ
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, they said you were truly beautiful.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Wait a moment! No, no, no!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Your expression is all wrong. It should
be more...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Dramatic, poetic... or flamboyant, at the
very
least!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Your flat, straight answer... How am I
supposed
build anything from that?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: There is just no... operatic impact.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... Stop, please. You assault me with
your
purity.
choice_data_list: 本音を言っただけだけど？
choice_data_list_en: I only said what I really thought, though?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I lack experience in these heart-to-heart

situations. You must add a bit of humor...
or
something...

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Daaah! I am done for... This is dire...
What is this
place?! What lies beneath
these hot springs?!
choice_data_list: 美しいな、テイエムオペラオー
美しいよ、テイエムオペラオー
choice_data_list_en: You look magnificent, T.M. Opera O.
You look magnificent, T.M. Opera O.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The aura of the Centurial Overlord is...
melting
away... I surrender! I wave the
white flaaag!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Of all things, this has turned out to be
Opera O's
weak point, leaving her
totally vulnerable.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Gasp... Pant... I must... overcome!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Before this vacation is over, I must
become
resistant to your guileless
diction.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
A tactical retreat to the thermae is in
order! I shall
return once my vigor has
been restored!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Do not forget this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's a siege at the hot springs. Next, I
shower her
in a heavier volley of
compliments.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I sense that Opera O and I have formed
an
irreplaceable bond during this time
together.
